info.name: NASA FIRMS Area Fire Detections API

params.name: map_key
params.description: Free MAP_KEY obtained via registration at https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/map_key/. Rate limited to 5000 transactions per 10-minute interval. Larger requests (e.g., 7-day queries) may count as multiple transactions.

params.name: area_coordinates
params.description: Bounding box in west,south,east,north format (decimal degrees), or the string "world" for global coverage [-180,-90,180,90].

params.name: day_range
params.description: Number of days to include in the query (1 to 5).

items.docs: Returns active fire detection hotspots within the specified bounding box for the most recent DAY_RANGE days (today back to today minus DAY_RANGE-1). Results are returned in CSV format.

info.name: Get area fire detections starting from a specific date

params.name: map_key
params.description: Free MAP_KEY obtained via registration at https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/map_key/. Rate limited to 5000 transactions per 10-minute interval. Larger requests (e.g., 7-day queries) may count as multiple transactions.

params.name: area_coordinates
params.description: Bounding box in west,south,east,north format (decimal degrees), or the string "world" for global coverage [-180,-90,180,90].

params.name: day_range
params.description: Number of days to include in the query (1 to 5).

params.name: date
params.description: Start date for the query in YYYY-MM-DD format.

items.docs: Returns active fire detection hotspots within the specified bounding box starting from the given DATE and spanning DAY_RANGE days forward (DATE to DATE + DAY_RANGE - 1). Results are returned in CSV format.
